headline: Reagan, 1985: Free rides for *tax evaders* are over
quote: There is one group of losers in our tax plan. Those individuals and corporations who are not paying their fair share
title: President Reagan, 1985: Why are tax system free rides ending?
caption: The 1985 tax reform proposal aimed to target corporate and individual loopholes. President Reagan stated that those avoiding taxes would now be required to pay.
comment: Should the tax code eliminate all special industry preferences?
